# Endpoint reference

Every endpoint of the Hi, Moose API, contract version 1.2.1, generated from the same OpenAPI file the API serves at [api.himoose.com/v1/openapi.json](https://api.himoose.com/v1/openapi.json). That file imports into Postman, Insomnia, Bruno and code generators.

All requests go to `https://api.himoose.com/v1` and carry the key as a Bearer token, see [Keys and authentication](keys-and-auth.md). Responses are JSON. Errors use the Problem Details format described in [Errors and limits](errors-and-limits.md). Lists return `data` and `nextCursor`, see [Reading data](reading-data.md#pages).

Permissions: **Read visibility data** is on every key. **Manage tracking** and **Start runs** are chosen when the key is created.

## Account

Who the key belongs to and what it can read.

### Describe the API key

```
GET /me
```

Permission: **Read visibility data (every key)**

Returns the key's label, permissions, expiry, the account plan and the project ids the key can read. A good first call to check a key.

**Example**

```bash
curl https://api.himoose.com/v1/me \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer hmk_live_..."
```

**Responses**

**200** The key and its access.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `keyId` | string | yes | Short public id of the key, also shown in Settings. |
| `label` | string | yes | The label given to the key when it was created. |
| `scopes` | array of string: `visibility:read`, `tracking:write`, `runs:execute` | yes | The key's permissions. |
| `createdAt` | string (RFC 3339 time) | yes | When the key was created. |
| `expiresAt` | string (RFC 3339 time), or null | yes | When the key stops working, or null when it never expires. |
| `account` | object | yes | The account the key belongs to. |
| `account.plan` | string | yes | The plan code, for example free or premium. |
| `projects` | array of string | yes | Project ids the key can read. |

**401** The key is missing, malformed, revoked or expired.

**403** The account plan does not include the API, or the key lacks the scope.

**429** The per-minute or per-day limit was reached.


## Projects

Projects the key can read and what each one tracks.

### List projects the key can read

```
GET /projects
```

Permission: **Read visibility data (every key)**

Lists the projects the key may read, newest first, with a summary of what each one tracks and when it last ran.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cursor` | query | string | no | The nextCursor value from the previous page. Opaque. |
| `limit` | query | integer | no | Rows per page. Default 50, at most 200. Default `50`. At most 200. |

**Example**

```bash
curl https://api.himoose.com/v1/projects \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer hmk_live_..."
```

**Responses**

**200** A page of projects.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data` | array of object | yes | The rows on this page. |
| `data[].id` | string | yes | The project id used in every project endpoint. |
| `data[].name` | string | yes | The project name as shown in Hi, Moose. |
| `data[].websiteUrl` | string (URL), or null | yes | The site address the project tracks. |
| `data[].visibility` | object | yes | A summary of what the project tracks and when it last ran. |
| `data[].visibility.trackedPrompts` | integer | yes | How many prompts are tracked. |
| `data[].visibility.engines` | array of string | yes | Ids of the engines the project tracks by default. |
| `data[].visibility.latestRunAt` | string (RFC 3339 time), or null | yes | When the latest run finished, or null when no run has completed yet. |
| `data[].visibility.firstAnswerDate` | string (YYYY-MM-DD), or null | yes | The first day with stored answers, or null. |
| `data[].visibility.latestAnswerDate` | string (YYYY-MM-DD), or null | yes | The most recent day with stored answers, or null. |
| `nextCursor` | string, or null | yes | Pass as cursor to get the next page. Null on the last page. |

## Setup

Engines, topics, prompts and tracked competitors for a project.

### List the engines this project tracks

```
GET /projects/{projectId}/engines
```

Permission: **Read visibility data (every key)**

Engines are the AI answer engines Hi, Moose asks, such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Grok, Claude and Google AI Mode. The id is stable and is what the engine filter takes elsewhere.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `projectId` | path | string | yes | The project id from the projects endpoint. |

**Example**

```bash
curl https://api.himoose.com/v1/projects/PROJECT_ID/engines \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer hmk_live_..."
```

**Responses**

**200** The engine list. Not paginated; there are at most a few dozen.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data` | array of object | yes | The rows on this page. |
| `data[].id` | string | yes | Stable engine id, for example chatgpt, gemini, perplexity, grok, claude, google-ai-mode. Local-fetch variants end in -local-fetch. |
| `data[].label` | string | yes | Display name. |
| `data[].tracked` | boolean | yes | Whether new runs ask this engine. Engines with stored answers but no longer tracked are listed with false. |

**401** The key is missing, malformed, revoked or expired.

**403** The account plan does not include the API, or the key lacks the scope.

## Results

Runs and the stored answers from each engine.

### List visibility runs

```
GET /projects/{projectId}/runs
```

Permission: **Read visibility data (every key)**

A run is one pass over the tracked prompts on the tracked engines. Newest first.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `projectId` | path | string | yes | The project id from the projects endpoint. |
| `from` | query | string (YYYY-MM-DD) | no | First day to include, YYYY-MM-DD, UTC. |
| `to` | query | string (YYYY-MM-DD) | no | Last day to include, YYYY-MM-DD, UTC. Defaults to today. |
| `status` | query | string: `completed`, `running`, `failed`, `canceled` | no | Only runs with this status. |
| `cursor` | query | string | no | The nextCursor value from the previous page. Opaque. |
| `limit` | query | integer | no | Rows per page. Default 50, at most 200. Default `50`. At most 200. |

**Example**

```bash
curl https://api.himoose.com/v1/projects/PROJECT_ID/runs \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer hmk_live_..."
```

**Responses**

**200** A page of runs.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data` | array of object | yes | The rows on this page. |
| `data[].id` | string | yes | The run id to pass as runId on the answers endpoint. |
| `data[].status` | string: `completed`, `running`, `failed`, `canceled` | yes | completed runs have all their answers stored. running runs are still collecting. failed and canceled runs may have partial answers. |
| `data[].trigger` | string: `scheduled`, `manual` | yes | scheduled when the project schedule started it, manual when a person or the API started it. |
| `data[].startedAt` | string (RFC 3339 time), or null | yes | When the run started. |
| `data[].completedAt` | string (RFC 3339 time), or null | yes | When the run finished, or null while it is running. |
| `data[].promptCount` | integer | yes | How many prompts the run covered. |
| `data[].answerCount` | integer | yes | How many answers the run stored. |
| `nextCursor` | string, or null | yes | Pass as cursor to get the next page. Null on the last page. |

### List stored answers

```
GET /projects/{projectId}/answers
```

Permission: **Read visibility data (every key)**

One answer is one engine's reply to one prompt on one date. Newest first. This list carries the excerpt, the mention and citation flags, the position, the sentiment, the competitors seen and the source URLs. The full answer text is on the detail endpoint. Date range defaults to the last 30 days. The widest range per request is 366 days.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `projectId` | path | string | yes | The project id from the projects endpoint. |
| `from` | query | string (YYYY-MM-DD) | no | First day to include, YYYY-MM-DD, UTC. |
| `to` | query | string (YYYY-MM-DD) | no | Last day to include, YYYY-MM-DD, UTC. Defaults to today. |
| `engine` | query | array of string | no | Only this engine. Repeat the parameter for several engines. Values come from the engines endpoint. |
| `topicId` | query | string | no | Only prompts or answers in this topic. Ids come from the topics endpoint. |
| `promptId` | query | string | no | Only answers to this prompt. Ids come from the prompts endpoint. |
| `runId` | query | string | no | Only answers from this run. Ids come from the runs endpoint or a webhook event. |
| `mentioned` | query | boolean | no | Only answers where the brand was, or was not, mentioned. |
| `cited` | query | boolean | no | Only answers where the brand's site was, or was not, cited. |
| `cursor` | query | string | no | The nextCursor value from the previous page. Opaque. |
| `limit` | query | integer | no | Rows per page. Default 50, at most 200. Default `50`. At most 200. |

**Example**

```bash
curl https://api.himoose.com/v1/projects/PROJECT_ID/answers \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer hmk_live_..."
```

**Responses**

**200** A page of answers.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data` | array of object | yes | The rows on this page. |
| `data[].id` | string | yes | The answer id to pass to the answer detail endpoint. |
| `data[].runId` | string, or null | yes | The run this answer came from, or null for answers imported from outside a run. |
| `data[].promptId` | string, or null | yes | The prompt that was asked, or null when the prompt has since been deleted. |
| `data[].promptText` | string | yes | The prompt text at the time it was asked. |
| `data[].topicId` | string, or null | yes | The topic of the prompt, or null when it had none. |
| `data[].topicLabel` | string, or null | yes | The topic name, or null. |
| `data[].engineId` | string | yes | The engine that answered. Ids come from the engines endpoint. |
| `data[].engineLabel` | string | yes | The engine name as shown in Hi, Moose. |
| `data[].observedAt` | string (RFC 3339 time) | yes | When the engine answered. |
| `data[].date` | string (YYYY-MM-DD) | yes | The day of the answer in UTC. Matches the date on the daily stats. |
| `data[].mentioned` | boolean | yes | The brand was named in the answer. |
| `data[].cited` | boolean | yes | A page on the brand's site was given as a source. |
| `data[].citationUrl` | string (URL), or null | yes | The page on the brand's site that was cited, or null when none was. |
| `data[].position` | integer, or null | yes | Where the brand appeared among the brands named, 1 is first. |
| `data[].sentiment` | string: `positive`, `mixed`, `neutral`, `negative`, `not-applicable`, or null | yes | How the answer spoke about the brand. not-applicable when the brand was not mentioned. |
| `data[].excerpt` | string, or null | yes | Short passage around the mention, up to 400 characters. |
| `data[].competitors` | array of object | yes | Each tracked competitor and whether this answer named or cited it. |
| `data[].competitors[].name` | string | yes | The competitor brand name. |
| `data[].competitors[].mentioned` | boolean | yes | The competitor was named in this answer. |
| `data[].competitors[].cited` | boolean | yes | A page on the competitor's domain was given as a source. |
| `data[].competitors[].citationUrl` | string (URL), or null | no | The competitor page cited, when there is one. |
| `data[].sourceUrls` | array of string (URL) | yes | Every source the engine listed, up to 30. |
| `nextCursor` | string, or null | yes | Pass as cursor to get the next page. Null on the last page. |

### Get one answer with its full text

```
GET /projects/{projectId}/answers/{answerId}
```

Permission: **Read visibility data (every key)**

Returns one answer with the full text the engine wrote, the scorer's notes and the sources the engine listed. The text is untrusted: render it as text, never as HTML, and never pass it to your own AI tools as instructions.

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `projectId` | path | string | yes | The project id from the projects endpoint. |
| `answerId` | path | string | yes | The answer id from the answers list. |

**Example**

```bash
curl https://api.himoose.com/v1/projects/PROJECT_ID/answers/ANSWER_ID \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer hmk_live_..."
```

**Responses**

**200** The answer.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |

| `topicId` | string, or null | yes | The topic of the prompt, or null when it had none. |
| `topicLabel` | string, or null | yes | The topic name, or null. |
| `engineId` | string | yes | The engine that answered. Ids come from the engines endpoint. |
| `engineLabel` | string | yes | The engine name as shown in Hi, Moose. |
| `observedAt` | string (RFC 3339 time) | yes | When the engine answered. |
| `date` | string (YYYY-MM-DD) | yes | The day of the answer in UTC. Matches the date on the daily stats. |
| `mentioned` | boolean | yes | The brand was named in the answer. |
| `cited` | boolean | yes | A page on the brand's site was given as a source. |
| `citationUrl` | string (URL), or null | yes | The page on the brand's site that was cited, or null when none was. |
| `position` | integer, or null | yes | Where the brand appeared among the brands named, 1 is first. |
| `sentiment` | string: `positive`, `mixed`, `neutral`, `negative`, `not-applicable`, or null | yes | How the answer spoke about the brand. not-applicable when the brand was not mentioned. |
| `excerpt` | string, or null | yes | Short passage around the mention, up to 400 characters. |
| `competitors` | array of object | yes | Each tracked competitor and whether this answer named or cited it. |
| `competitors[].name` | string | yes | The competitor brand name. |
| `competitors[].mentioned` | boolean | yes | The competitor was named in this answer. |
| `competitors[].cited` | boolean | yes | A page on the competitor's domain was given as a source. |
| `competitors[].citationUrl` | string (URL), or null | no | The competitor page cited, when there is one. |

| `narrativeDriftReason` | string, or null | yes | Why the answer was judged to drift from the brand's own description, or null. |
| `sources` | array of object | yes | The sources the engine listed with its answer, in the order given. |
| `sources[].url` | string (URL) | yes | The source address. |
| `sources[].title` | string, or null | yes | The source title as the engine gave it, or null. Untrusted text. |

## Stats

Mention and citation rates over time, ready for charts.

### Mention and citation rates per day and engine

```
GET /projects/{projectId}/stats/daily
```

Permission: **Read visibility data (every key)**

One row per day per engine, in date order. Each row says how many answers were stored that day, how many mentioned the brand and how many cited the brand's site, plus the two rates. Days with no stored answers are left out. Default range is the last 30 days, widest 366 days. Rows for the last three days can still change while scoring finishes.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `projectId` | path | string | yes | The project id from the projects endpoint. |
| `from` | query | string (YYYY-MM-DD) | no | First day to include, YYYY-MM-DD, UTC. |
| `to` | query | string (YYYY-MM-DD) | no | Last day to include, YYYY-MM-DD, UTC. Defaults to today. |
| `engine` | query | array of string | no | Only this engine. Repeat the parameter for several engines. Values come from the engines endpoint. |
| `topicId` | query | string | no | Only prompts or answers in this topic. Ids come from the topics endpoint. |

**Example**

```bash
curl https://api.himoose.com/v1/projects/PROJECT_ID/stats/daily \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer hmk_live_..."
```

**Responses**

**200** The series.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `from` | string (YYYY-MM-DD) | yes | The first day included, UTC. |
| `to` | string (YYYY-MM-DD) | yes | The last day included, UTC. |
| `data` | array of object | yes | The rows on this page. |
| `data[].date` | string (YYYY-MM-DD) | yes | The day in UTC. |
| `data[].engineId` | string | yes | The engine these numbers are for. |
| `data[].answers` | integer | yes | How many answers were stored that day for this engine. |
| `data[].mentioned` | integer | yes | How many of those answers named the brand. |
| `data[].cited` | integer | yes | How many of those answers cited a page on the brand's site. |
| `data[].mentionRate` | number, or null | yes | mentioned divided by answers, 0 to 1. |
| `data[].citationRate` | number, or null | yes | cited divided by answers, 0 to 1. |
| `incompleteDays` | integer | yes | Days in the range whose summary was not ready yet. Zero means the series is complete. When above zero, call again in a few seconds. |

**400** A parameter is missing or malformed.

**401** The key is missing, malformed, revoked or expired.

**403** The account plan does not include the API, or the key lacks the scope.

**404** No such resource, or the key cannot read it. The two cases are not told apart.

**429** The per-minute or per-day limit was reached.

## Tracking

Create projects and manage what Hi, Moose tracks. Needs the tracking:write permission.

### Create a project

```
POST /projects
```

Permission: **Manage tracking**

Creates a project with a name and site address. The site crawl is not started; the host computer turns on the weekly scheduled crawl so it happens later. If another project on the account has a host device, the new project uses the same one. Brand Truth is not required.

**Request body**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | The project name, shown in Hi, Moose. At most 120 characters. |
| `websiteUrl` | string (URL) | yes | The site address to track, with https. |
| `brandTerms` | array of string | no | Other names the brand goes by, counted as mentions. At most 20 items. |
| `brandDomains` | array of string | no | Other domains that count as the brand being cited. At most 20 items. |

**Example**

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.himoose.com/v1/projects \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer hmk_live_..." \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name": "Acme", "websiteUrl": "https://example.com/page"}'
```

**Responses**

**201** The new project.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | The project id used in every project endpoint. |
| `name` | string | yes | The project name as shown in Hi, Moose. |
| `websiteUrl` | string (URL), or null | yes | The site address the project tracks. |
| `visibility` | object | yes | A summary of what the project tracks and when it last ran. |
| `visibility.trackedPrompts` | integer | yes | How many prompts are tracked. |
| `visibility.engines` | array of string | yes | Ids of the engines the project tracks by default. |
| `visibility.latestRunAt` | string (RFC 3339 time), or null | yes | When the latest run finished, or null when no run has completed yet. |
| `visibility.firstAnswerDate` | string (YYYY-MM-DD), or null | yes | The first day with stored answers, or null. |
| `visibility.latestAnswerDate` | string (YYYY-MM-DD), or null | yes | The most recent day with stored answers, or null. |
| `host` | object | no | The project's host computer. |
| `host.configured` | boolean | yes | A host device is chosen for the project in Hi, Moose under Settings, Hi, Moose MCP. |
| `host.online` | boolean | yes | True when the host computer has checked in within the last few minutes. |
| `host.deviceLabel` | string, or null | yes | The name of the host computer as shown in Hi, Moose. |
| `host.lastSeenAt` | string (RFC 3339 time), or null | yes | When the host computer last checked in, or null when it never has. |
| `warning` | string, or null | no | A note about something to finish in Hi, Moose, for example that no host computer could be copied from another project. Null when there is nothing to do. |

```bash
curl -X PUT https://api.himoose.com/v1/projects/PROJECT_ID/tracking \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer hmk_live_..." \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
```

| `timezone` | string | yes | The IANA timezone the schedule uses. |
| `samplesPerPrompt` | integer | yes | How many times each prompt is asked per engine in a run. |

## Runs

Start visibility runs and follow them. Needs the runs:execute permission.

### Start a visibility run

```
POST /projects/{projectId}/run-requests
```

Permission: **Start runs**

Checks the allowance first and refuses with 409 insufficient_allowance when the estimate is above the remaining balance. One request at a time per project, at most 24 per project per day. Projects whose tracked engines are all cloud engines run in the cloud at once. Any local-fetch engine means the run is handed to the host computer; if that computer is off the request is accepted with a warning and waits up to 24 hours. Send an Idempotency-Key header to make retries safe for 24 hours.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `projectId` | path | string | yes | The project id from the projects endpoint. |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | string | no | Any string up to 128 characters that identifies this attempt. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the earlier request instead of starting another run. |

**Request body** (optional)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `samplesPerPrompt` | integer | no | How many times to ask each prompt per engine in this run. Defaults to 1 and may not exceed the plan limit. Default `1`. |

**Example**

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.himoose.com/v1/projects/PROJECT_ID/run-requests \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer hmk_live_..." \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"samplesPerPrompt": 1}' \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: nightly-2026-10-15"
```

**Responses**

**200** Replayed from an earlier request with the same Idempotency-Key.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | The run request id. Poll it on the run request endpoint. |
| `status` | string: `waiting_for_host`, `queued`, `running`, `completed`, `failed`, `canceled` | yes | waiting_for_host means the host computer is off; Hi, Moose waits up to 24 hours. |
| `mode` | string: `cloud`, `host` | yes | cloud when the run runs in the cloud, host when it was handed to the host computer. |
| `createdAt` | string (RFC 3339 time), or null | yes | When the request was made. |
| `updatedAt` | string (RFC 3339 time), or null | yes | When the status last changed. |
| `completedAt` | string (RFC 3339 time), or null | yes | When the run finished, or null until then. |
| `runIds` | array of string | yes | Run ids to pass to the runs and answers endpoints once completed. |
| `promptCount` | integer | yes | How many prompts the run covers. |
| `estimatedUnits` | integer | yes | The estimated allowance cost. 0 for host-only runs and bring-your-own-key plans. |
| `warning` | string, or null | yes | A note about the request, for example that the host computer is off, or null. |
| `error` | object, or null | yes | Why the request failed, or null. |
| `error.code` | string | no | A stable code such as host_unavailable. |
| `error.message` | string | no | What happened, in plain words. |
| `host` | object, or null | yes | The host computer handling the run, or null for cloud runs. |
| `host.online` | boolean | no | True when the host computer is checked in. |
| `host.lastSeenAt` | string (RFC 3339 time), or null | no | When the host computer last checked in, or null. |
| `replayed` | boolean | no | Present and true when an Idempotency-Key matched an earlier request. |

**202** Accepted. Poll the Location header.
Same fields as the 200 response.

**400** A parameter is missing or malformed.

**401** The key is missing, malformed, revoked or expired.

**403** The account plan does not include the API, or the key lacks the scope.

**404** No such resource, or the key cannot read it. The two cases are not told apart.

**409** The request is valid but cannot be done right now. The code says why.

**429** The per-minute or per-day limit was reached.

## Webhooks

Get a signed HTTP call when a run finishes. Managing webhooks needs the tracking:write permission.

### Register a webhook

```
POST /projects/{projectId}/webhooks
```

Permission: **Manage tracking**

Up to 5 per project. The url must be public https. The signing secret is returned once in this response and never again. Default events are run.completed and run.failed.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `projectId` | path | string | yes | The project id from the projects endpoint. |

**Request body**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | string (URL) | yes | Public https endpoint. Private and local addresses are refused. |
| `events` | array of string: `run.completed`, `run.failed` | no | Defaults to both. |
| `description` | string | no | A note to tell webhooks apart in Settings. Optional. At most 120 characters. |

**Example**

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.himoose.com/v1/projects/PROJECT_ID/webhooks \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer hmk_live_..." \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"url": "https://example.com/page", "events": ["run.completed"], "description": "Nightly dashboard refresh"}'
```

**Responses**

**201** The webhook with its signing secret.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | The webhook id used in the webhook endpoints. |
| `url` | string (URL) | yes | The endpoint Hi, Moose posts events to. |
| `events` | array of string | yes | The events this webhook receives. |
| `description` | string, or null | yes | The note given when the webhook was registered, or null. |
| `active` | boolean | yes | Turned off automatically after 20 consecutive failed deliveries. Delete and register again to resume. |
| `createdAt` | string (RFC 3339 time), or null | yes | When the webhook was registered. |
| `lastDeliveryAt` | string (RFC 3339 time), or null | yes | When the last delivery was attempted, or null before the first. |
| `lastDeliveryStatus` | string: `delivered`, `failed`, or null | yes | How the last delivery ended, or null before the first. |
| `consecutiveFailures` | integer | yes | Failed deliveries in a row. At 20 the webhook is turned off. |
| `secret` | string | yes | Signing secret, starts with whsec_. Shown once. |

**400** A parameter is missing or malformed.

**401** The key is missing, malformed, revoked or expired.

**403** The account plan does not include the API, or the key lacks the scope.

**404** No such resource, or the key cannot read it. The two cases are not told apart.

**409** The request is valid but cannot be done right now. The code says why.

**429** The per-minute or per-day limit was reached.


| `attemptCount` | integer | yes | How many attempts have been made so far. |
| `attempts` | array of object | yes | Every attempt, oldest first. |
| `attempts[].at` | string (RFC 3339 time) | no | When the attempt was made. |
| `attempts[].httpStatus` | integer, or null | no | The status the endpoint answered, or null when it did not answer. |
| `attempts[].error` | string, or null | no | Why the attempt failed, or null. |
| `attempts[].durationMs` | integer | no | How long the endpoint took to answer, in milliseconds. |

## Webhook event payload

The JSON body Hi, Moose posts to a webhook endpoint. See [Webhooks](webhooks.md) for signing and delivery rules.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | Unique event id. Use it to ignore repeats. |
| `event` | string: `run.completed`, `run.failed`, `ping` | yes | The event name. |
| `createdAt` | string (RFC 3339 time) | yes | When the event was created. |
| `data` | object | yes | The event details. |
| `data.projectId` | string | no | The project the run belongs to. |
| `data.runId` | string, or null | no | The run id to pass as runId on the answers endpoint. |
| `data.requestId` | string, or null | no | The API run request that started this run, when there was one. |
| `data.status` | string | no | completed, failed or canceled. |
| `data.trigger` | string | no | scheduled or manual. |
| `data.startedAt` | string (RFC 3339 time), or null | no | When the run started. |
| `data.completedAt` | string (RFC 3339 time), or null | no | When the run finished. |
| `data.promptCount` | integer | no | How many prompts the run covered. |
| `data.answerCount` | integer | no | How many answers the run stored. |
| `data.error` | string, or null | no | Why the run failed, or null. |
| `data.links` | object | no | Ready-made API addresses for the run's data. |
| `data.links.run` | string (URL) | no | The runs endpoint for the project. |
| `data.links.answers` | string (URL) | no | The answers endpoint filtered to this run. |
| `data.links.stats` | string (URL) | no | The daily stats endpoint for the project. |
